answer.description: The answer, or the part of it written before a failure.

model.description: The model that served the final response.

promptTokens.description: Prompt tokens, summed over every request.

completionTokens.description: Completion tokens, summed over every request.

totalTokens.description: Total tokens, summed over every request.

reasoningTokens.description: Tokens the model spent thinking. Present when at least one request reported them.

cachedTokens.description: Prompt tokens the provider served from its cache. Present when at least one request reported them.

cost.description: Cost in US dollars, summed over every request. Present only when every request reported one.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: What the question used, over every request it took.

thinking.description: The readable thinking of the model. Absent when there is none.

traceId.description: The Langfuse trace id. Absent when the run is not traced.

oneOf.title: Success
oneOf.description: The run ended with an answer. Written to stdout.

question.description: The question. Absent when the failure came before it was known.

answer.description: The text written before the failure. Absent when there is none.

thinking.description: The readable thinking of the model. Absent when there is none.

traceId.description: The Langfuse trace id. Absent when the run is not traced.

code.description: A short stable name for the kind of failure, such as API_ERROR.

message.description: What went wrong, in words for the user.

oneOf.title: Failure
oneOf.description: The run failed. Written to stderr.

title: openrouter-langfuse-agent-ts --json output
description: The object the CLI writes under --json: a success on stdout, a failure on stderr.
